#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Self checks for the Eywa offline campaign toolkit.

Run with `python3 tests/test_toolkit.py`.  The checks drive the pipeline
in-process and also exercise the command line framing end to end.
"""

import base64
import json
import os
import struct
import subprocess
import sys

HERE = os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__))
ROOT = os.path.dirname(HERE)
sys.path.insert(0, os.path.join(ROOT, "src"))

from eywa.offline import execute  # noqa: E402

FAILURES = []


def check(name, got, want):
    if got != want:
        FAILURES.append(name)
        print("FAIL %s\n  got  %r\n  want %r" % (name, got, want))
    else:
        print("ok   %s" % name)


def ktest(objects, args=(), version=3, trailing=b""):
    """Build a base64 KTEST version 3 payload."""
    out = b"KTEST" + struct.pack(">I", version) + struct.pack(">I", len(args))
    for argument in args:
        out += struct.pack(">I", len(argument)) + argument
    out += struct.pack(">I", 0) + struct.pack(">I", 0)
    out += struct.pack(">I", len(objects))
    for name, data in objects:
        name = name.encode() if isinstance(name, str) else name
        if isinstance(data, int):
            data = bytes([data])
        out += struct.pack(">I", len(name)) + name
        out += struct.pack(">I", len(data)) + data
    return base64.b64encode(out + trailing).decode()


def unsigned(value, width):
    return int(value).to_bytes(width, "little", signed=False)


def campaign(types, modules, runs, calls=None, pipes=None, entries=None,
             machine=None):
    return {"types": types, "modules": modules, "calls": calls or [],
            "pipes": pipes or [], "entries": entries or ["main"],
            "machine": machine, "runs": runs}


NUMERIC = [{"name": "N", "kind": "int", "bits": 32},
           {"name": "Flag", "kind": "bool"}]


def test_layout():
    types = [{"name": "Point", "kind": "struct",
              "fields": [["x", "Word"], ["y", "Word"]]},
             {"name": "Word", "kind": "int", "bits": 32},
             {"name": "Flag", "kind": "bool"},
             {"name": "Line", "kind": "struct",
              "fields": [["a", "Point"], ["b", "Point"], ["tag", "Flag"]]},
             {"name": "Tag", "kind": "enum", "values": ["one", "two"]},
             {"name": "Names", "kind": "array", "element": "Tag", "size": 2},
             {"name": "PointAlias", "kind": "alias", "target": "Point"}]
    modules = [{"name": "draw",
                "params": [["pts", "Line"], ["tags", "Names"],
                           ["mirror", "PointAlias"]],
                "result": ["ok", "Flag"], "requires": None}]
    plan = execute(campaign(types, modules, [], entries=["draw"]))["plans"][0]
    check("layout slots", plan["slots"],
          [["x2", ["pts", "a", "x"], 4], ["x3", ["pts", "a", "y"], 4],
           ["x5", ["pts", "b", "x"], 4], ["x6", ["pts", "b", "y"], 4],
           ["x7", ["pts", "tag"], 1], ["x9", ["tags", 0], 4],
           ["x10", ["tags", 1], 4], ["x12", ["mirror", "x"], 4],
           ["x13", ["mirror", "y"], 4], ["x14", ["ok"], 1]])
    check("layout declarations", plan["types"],
          ["Point", "Line", "Tag", "PointAlias"])
    check("layout variables", plan["variables"], 15)
    check("layout flag", plan["flag"], None)


def test_strings():
    types = [{"name": "S", "kind": "string", "maxsize": 3},
             {"name": "Flag", "kind": "bool"}]
    modules = [{"name": "main", "params": [["s", "S"]], "result": ["r", "Flag"],
                "requires": None}]
    runs = [{"entry": "main",
             "ktest": ktest([("x1", b"a"), ("x2", b"\x00"), ("x3", b"b"),
                             ("x4", b"\x01")])}]
    out = execute(campaign(types, modules, runs))
    check("string truncates at NUL", out["corpus"][0]["inputs"], {"s": "a"})
    check("string slots", out["plans"][0]["slots"],
          [["x1", ["s", 0], 1], ["x2", ["s", 1], 1], ["x3", ["s", 2], 1],
           ["x4", ["r"], 1]])


def test_pipes_and_flags():
    modules = [{"name": "main", "params": [["n", "N"]], "result": ["r", "Flag"],
                "requires": None},
               {"name": "filt", "params": [["v", "N"]], "result": ["fr", "Flag"],
                "requires": ["gt", ["var", "v"], ["const", "N", 10]]}]
    pipes = [{"target": "main", "filter": "filt", "bind": {"v": "n"}}]

    def witness(value, flag):
        return {"entry": "main",
                "ktest": ktest([("x0", unsigned(value, 4)), ("x1", b"\x01"),
                                ("x2", bytes([flag]))])}

    out = execute(campaign(NUMERIC, modules,
                            [witness(50, 0), witness(5, 1), witness(5, 0)],
                            pipes=pipes))
    check("pipe plan", out["plans"][0]["modules"], ["filt", "main"])
    check("pipe flag name", out["plans"][0]["flag"], "x2")
    check("pipe records", [record["status"] for record in out["records"]],
          ["READY", "FILTERED", "INVALID_TEST"])


def test_invalid_tests():
    modules = [{"name": "main", "params": [["n", "N"]], "result": ["r", "Flag"],
                "requires": None}]
    good = [("x0", unsigned(3, 4)), ("x1", b"\x01")]
    cases = {
        "base64": {"entry": "main", "ktest": "not base64"},
        "missing": {"entry": "main", "ktest": ktest(good[:1])},
        "unknown": {"entry": "main", "ktest": ktest(good + [("x9", b"\x00")])},
        "duplicate": {"entry": "main", "ktest": ktest(good + good[:1])},
        "width": {"entry": "main",
                  "ktest": ktest([("x0", unsigned(3, 2)), ("x1", b"\x01")])},
        "trailing": {"entry": "main", "ktest": ktest(good, trailing=b"\x00")},
        "leaf": {"entry": "main",
                 "ktest": ktest([("x0", unsigned(3, 4)), ("x1", b"\x02")])},
    }
    for name, run in cases.items():
        out = execute(campaign(NUMERIC, modules, [run]))
        check("invalid " + name, out["records"][0]["status"], "INVALID_TEST")


def test_predicates():
    types = [{"name": "N", "kind": "int", "bits": 32},
             {"name": "Flag", "kind": "bool"},
             {"name": "Pt", "kind": "struct", "fields": [["x", "N"], ["y", "N"]]},
             {"name": "Arr", "kind": "array", "element": "Pt", "size": 2},
             {"name": "S", "kind": "string", "maxsize": 5}]

    def status(requires, values):
        modules = [{"name": "main",
                    "params": [["a", "Arr"], ["s", "S"], ["n", "N"]],
                    "result": ["r", "Flag"], "requires": requires}]
        objects = [("x2", unsigned(values[0][0], 4)),
                   ("x3", unsigned(values[0][1], 4)),
                   ("x5", unsigned(values[1][0], 4)),
                   ("x6", unsigned(values[1][1], 4))]
        text = (values[2] + "\x00" * 5).encode("latin-1")[:5]
        for index in range(5):
            objects.append(("x%d" % (8 + index), text[index:index + 1]))
        objects.append(("x13", unsigned(values[3], 4)))
        objects.append(("x14", b"\x01"))
        out = execute(campaign(types, modules,
                                [{"entry": "main", "ktest": ktest(objects)}]))
        return out["records"][0]["status"]

    check("all over a struct field",
          status(["all", "p", ["var", "a"],
                  ["gt", ["field", ["var", "p"], "x"], ["const", "N", 0]]],
                 ((1, 2), (3, 4)), "abc", 0), "READY")
    check("all rejects",
          status(["all", "p", ["var", "a"],
                  ["gt", ["field", ["var", "p"], "x"], ["const", "N", 2]]],
                 ((1, 2), (3, 4)), "abc", 0), "FILTERED")
    check("match accepts", status(["match", ["var", "s"], "[a-c]*"],
                                  ((0, 0), (0, 0)), "abc", 0), "READY")
    check("match rejects", status(["match", ["var", "s"], "[a-c]*"],
                                  ((0, 0), (0, 0)), "xyz", 0), "FILTERED")
    check("add wraps modulo",
          status(["eq", ["add", ["var", "n"], ["const", "N", 4294967295]],
                  ["const", "N", 0]], ((0, 0), (0, 0)), "", 1), "READY")
    check("sub wraps modulo",
          status(["eq", ["sub", ["var", "n"], ["const", "N", 1]],
                  ["const", "N", 4294967295]], ((0, 0), (0, 0)), "", 0), "READY")
    check("implies", status(["implies", ["eq", ["var", "n"], ["const", "N", 5]],
                             ["eq", ["var", "n"], ["const", "N", 1]]],
                            ((0, 0), (0, 0)), "", 0), "READY")


def test_state_machine():
    types = [{"name": "St", "kind": "enum", "values": ["S0", "S1", "S2"]},
             {"name": "Msg", "kind": "string", "maxsize": 4},
             {"name": "Flag", "kind": "bool"}]
    modules = [{"name": "main", "params": [["st", "St"], ["msg", "Msg"]],
                "result": ["r", "Flag"], "requires": None}]
    machine = {"states": ["S0", "S1", "S2"], "initial": "S0",
               "state_param": "st", "message_param": "msg",
               "transitions": [
                   {"from": "S0", "to": "S1", "command": "go", "cost": 3,
                    "when": None},
                   {"from": "S1", "to": "S2", "command": "next", "cost": 5,
                    "when": None}]}

    def witness(state, message):
        objects = [("x0", unsigned(state, 4))]
        text = (message + "\x00" * 4).encode("latin-1")[:4]
        for index in range(4):
            objects.append(("x%d" % (2 + index), text[index:index + 1]))
        objects.append(("x6", b"\x00"))
        return {"entry": "main", "ktest": ktest(objects)}

    out = execute(campaign(types, modules,
                            [witness(0, "hi"), witness(1, "hi"),
                             witness(2, "hi")], machine=machine))
    check("state preparations",
          [(case["commands"], case["cost"]) for case in out["corpus"]],
          [(["hi"], 0), (["go", "hi"], 3), (["go", "next", "hi"], 8)])

    unreachable = {"states": ["S0", "S1", "S2"], "initial": "S0",
                   "state_param": "st", "message_param": "msg",
                   "transitions": [
                       {"from": "S0", "to": "S1", "command": "go", "cost": 3,
                        "when": None}]}
    out = execute(campaign(types, modules, [witness(2, "hi")],
                            machine=unreachable))
    check("unreachable state", out["records"][0]["status"], "UNREACHABLE")


def test_corpus_identity():
    modules = [{"name": "main", "params": [["n", "N"]], "result": ["r", "Flag"],
                "requires": None}]
    runs = [{"entry": "main",
             "ktest": ktest([("x0", unsigned(7, 4)), ("x1", b"\x01")])},
            {"entry": "main",
             "ktest": ktest([("x0", unsigned(7, 4)), ("x1", b"\x00")])},
            {"entry": "main",
             "ktest": ktest([("x0", unsigned(8, 4)), ("x1", b"\x01")])}]
    out = execute(campaign(NUMERIC, modules, runs))
    check("corpus records", [(record["status"], record.get("case"))
                             for record in out["records"]],
          [("READY", 0), ("DUPLICATE", 0), ("READY", 1)])
    check("corpus witnesses", out["corpus"][0]["witnesses"], [0, 1])
    check("corpus model results differ",
          [record["model_result"] for record in out["records"]],
          [True, False, True])


def test_command_line():
    cli = os.path.join(ROOT, "campaign_cli.py")
    empty = {"types": [], "modules": [], "calls": [], "pipes": [],
             "entries": [], "machine": None, "runs": []}
    process = subprocess.run([sys.executable, "-I", "-B", cli],
                             input=json.dumps(empty).encode(),
                             capture_output=True)
    check("command line exit", process.returncode, 0)
    check("command line output", json.loads(process.stdout.decode()),
          {"plans": [], "records": [], "corpus": []})
    for payload in (b"", b"{", b'{"a":1} {"b":2}', b'{"a":1,"a":2}'):
        process = subprocess.run([sys.executable, "-I", "-B", cli],
                                 input=payload, capture_output=True)
        check("command line rejects %r" % payload,
              json.loads(process.stdout.decode()),
              {"error": "INVALID_INPUT"})


def main():
    for test in (test_layout, test_strings, test_pipes_and_flags,
                 test_invalid_tests, test_predicates, test_state_machine,
                 test_corpus_identity, test_command_line):
        test()
    print()
    if FAILURES:
        print("%d failing checks: %s" % (len(FAILURES), ", ".join(FAILURES)))
        return 1
    print("all checks passed")
    return 0


if __name__ == "__main__":
    sys.exit(main())
PYEOF
